risk_note: RV2 by path (platform queue, entry). Daily purge of expired idempotency records (BR-ID-30 ⑤, orchestrator D10-448; the premise of D10-439): the worker runtime runs idempotency.purgeExpired() from an internal pg-boss schedule on an internal queue idempotency-purge, cron 0 20 * * * UTC (04:00 +08:00), the same way as dead-letter-scan (B1-01zzg): not a catalog queue, only the worker entry registers it, a restart upserts the same row, no retry and no dead letter, one extra lane outside the shared budget. Rows with expire_at past go regardless of status or app; expire_at = infinity (withdrawal and payout-account exception) stays. One log line with the deleted count only. purgeExpired semantics unchanged. No contract change, no migration.
